title: Authentic Chicken Biryani
ingredients: Pinch of Saffron or food coloring
steps: Marinate the chicken in yogurt, biryani masala, ginger garlic paste, and half the mint/coriander for 30 mins.
Fry the thinly sliced onions in oil until golden brown and crispy. Set half aside for garnish.
Add the marinated chicken to the remaining onions and cook until the oil separates and meat is tender.
In a separate large pot, boil the rice in heavily salted water until 70% cooked. Drain well.
Layer the chicken gravy at the bottom of a heavy pot, top with the par-boiled rice, fried onions, and a splash of saffron water.
Cover with a tight lid (dum) and cook on very low heat for 15-20 minutes. Fluff gently before serving.
